description: An EPANET INP network and an EPANET-MSX definition file simulate chlorine decay during contaminant backflow from a consumer. The two files provide hydraulic geometry and water-quality boundary conditions. This resource is provided by Endre Salamon. Coverage is site as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: CC BY 4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: Classified as a model because the files specify a runnable network scenario. The named emergency study remains subject to Q2. For simulation, it can support model-based scenario analysis.
